name: m0-readonly
_note: 只读诊断阶段（M0 收口）的用例。这一版探针只允许**读**：打印挂载点类型/几何、画布尺寸、roots 数量与名字。断言分两类：(1) 该打的行都打了；(2) 该不打的东西一个都没有 —— 没有建控件、没有改挂载点几何、没有开探测扫描。第 2 类是这次事故后的硬性要求（见 docs/tech-architecture.md §7）。

asserts.source:
assert(query.logContains('M0 readonly probe'), 'readonly banner missing')
assert(not query.logContains('M0 detect '), 'readonly probe must NOT scan templates')
assert(not query.logContains('M0 start built='), 'readonly probe must NOT build controls')
assert(not query.logContains('M0 writefail'), 'readonly probe must NOT write anything')
assert(not query.logContains('M0 mount pinned'), 'readonly probe must NOT pin mount geometry')
local loco = query.control('LOCO')
assert(loco == nil, 'readonly probe must not create LOCO')
local bg = query.control('BG')
assert(bg == nil, 'readonly probe must not create BG')

assert(not query.logContains('M0 start built='), 'still no building after 0.5s')
assert(not query.logContains('M0 detect '), 'still no scanning after 0.5s')
